meta.title: Cadastre overlap analysis
meta.method: Polygon intersection of 11,706 licensed cadastral blocks against 160 satellite-mapped mining footprints and 325 WDPA protected areas. Bounding-box prefilter on a 0.25 degree grid, then vertex-containment and edge-crossing tests.
meta.caveat: The footprint layer covers only 160 sites nationally and 35.7 km2. It is NOT a complete survey of Nigerian mining activity. Absence of a footprint therefore does NOT prove a title is dormant - it means no satellite-mapped working has been matched to it in this dataset. Treat the worked/unworked split as a lower bound on activity, not a compliance finding.
